summary: WCBEditAll manages bulk editing of Workers Compensation Board (WCB) status and waiver information for student enrollments. The user control offers workflows for saving, editing, and updating WCB-related fields for groups of students within a cohort, course, or term. Controls and validations are enforced to prevent unauthorized edits, reveal/hide UI elements contextually, and ensure field integrity.
purpose: Allows authorized users to view, filter, and mass-update WCB status and waiver details for students within Enrollment. Provides batch save, save-and-edit-next, and cancel functionalities, reflecting edits across paginated or filtered grids.

workflows.name: Bulk Edit WCB Statuses
steps: User loads the Enrollment grid with filter parameters (CohortID, TermID, CourseID, etc).
Grid queries and binds WCB status codes for each row.
User edits WCB status/waiver fields; edits are tracked with txtDirty flag.
User can save all edits (cmdSaveAll) or save and edit next group (cmdSaveEditNext).
System updates StudentPrerequisites.StudentDetailsSafetyWCBUpdate for each dirty student row.
If no warnings, redirect to Enrollment or next edit page; else display warnings.
In single edit mode, only save button is shown; in bulk mode, Save All and Save/Edit Next are available.
If grid row count < page size, some UI controls (Save All, Save/Edit Next) are hidden.

workflows.name: Filter and Display Enrollment
steps: User applies grid filters (section, action, campus, keyword, etc).
Filtered query is constructed; grid is re-bound.
Grid handles pagination and sorting; each page of rows re-binds status lists and controls.
UI dynamically hides/shows buttons and controls according to grid mode and row count.

business_rules: Edits are only allowed if blnReadOnly is false.
Save buttons and edit controls are hidden or shown based on EnrollmentID and row count.
WCBStatuses dropdown is populated from Codes.CodeSearch.
Waiver date/calendar controls are disabled for read-only users.
Each edit is tracked with txtDirty; only dirty rows trigger update.
validations: Check if UserSession is valid before allowing data selection.
Warnings from StudentDetailsSafetyWCBUpdate block redirect and must be shown.
calculations: ShowGrad, ShowInactive, ShowWaived fields determine which rows and controls are visible.
Pagination calculated using StartRow and PageSize.
conditions: If EnrollmentID != 0, only single row edit allowed; Save All button hidden.
If grid row count < page size or < 14, Save All/Edit Next controls hidden.
If blnReadOnly, disable calendar and edit fields.
system_behavior: Binds enrollment data and WCB statuses based on filters.
Tracks edits via hidden fields for each row.
Executes updates only for changed rows.
Redirects after successful save or displays warnings.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, data selection is canceled.
If warnings are generated during save, user is not redirected and must address them.
